output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import texttospeech

def synthesize_text(text: str, language_code: str = "en-US", voice_name: str = "en-US-Wavenet-D") -> bytes:
    """
    Synthesizes the given text into an audio byte stream using Google Cloud Text-to-Speech.

    Parameters
    ----------
    text : str
        The plain text to synthesize.
    language_code : str, default="en-US"
        BCP-47 language tag specifying the language of the text.
    voice_name : str, default="en-US-Wavenet-D"
        Name of the voice to use for synthesis. Must be a WaveNet voice.

    Returns
    -------
    bytes
        The synthesized audio in MP3 format.
    """
    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()
    synthesis_input = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=text)
    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(
        language_code=language_code, name=voice_name
    )
    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(
        audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3
    )
    response = client.synthesize_speech(
        input=synthesis_input, voice=voice, audio_config=audio_config
    )
    return response.audio_content
```
